Important dates

Application windowNot announced
Examination or testingNot announced
Result / counsellingNot announced

Eligibility

ANU publishes programme-wise qualifying degrees, subjects, marks, reservation, local status and certificates. Requirements can differ across postgraduate departments, so use the chosen programme notice.

Syllabus

  • Programme-specific postgraduate subjects
  • General aptitude or language where notified
  • Department and programme selection rules

Exam pattern

ANU must publish the 2027 registration window, papers, duration, marking, results and counselling or department-admission steps.

Question counts, marking and accessibility rules can change. The current official notice overrides older summaries.

How to apply

  1. Open the official portal and confirm the 2027 cycle or published calendar.
  2. Read the current notice, eligibility clause and document checklist.
  3. Register with an accessible email address and mobile number.
  4. Enter academic, identity and category details exactly as supported by documents.
  5. Upload files, pay only through the authorised gateway and save the confirmation page.
  6. Use the same login for corrections, admit card, result and counselling.

How to prepare

  • Turn the official syllabus into a topic checklist.

  • Keep an error log for concepts, calculation, reading and time management.
  • Track form, admit-card and counselling deadlines separately from study targets.

After the exam

A score is not an admission offer. Follow the official counselling, joining or recruitment instructions and pay only through the authorised page.
